description: How stressed a registry stablecoin's liquidity is against its peg default: a score from 0 to 100, its band and the four weighted components behind it. When to use: To score, from the XRP Ledger's own order books, AMM pool and issuer account, how stressed a registry stablecoin's liquidity is against its peg default, as one score with its band and the components behind it. Prefer another tool: To read the peg deviation of each price route (use `/v1/xrpl/metrics/peg`), or to check that an issued currency is the canonical registry coin and read its issuer posture (use `/v1/xrpl/stablecoin/{asset}`); for an asset outside the registry, which this route refuses, read its order book (`/v1/xrpl/orderbook`) or its AMM pool (`/v1/xrpl/amm/{a}/{b}`). Example: xrpl_metrics_liquidity_stress {"asset":"524C555344000000000000000000000000000000.rMxCKbEDwqr76QuheSUMdEGf4B9xJ8m5De"}

asset.description: XRPL stablecoin of the registry whose liquidity stress is measured against its peg default, by its canonical code and issuer: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.

name: xrpl_metrics_liquidity_stress

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

asset.description: The registry stablecoin measured against its peg default, as CODE.issuer (40-hex code)

asset_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `asset`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

band.description: Band of the score, a defined computation and not advice; null without a score

figure.description: The book statistic of the direct pair, in its base: spread_bps, spread / mid in basis points; depth_bid_k and depth_ask_k, the funded base quantity of the bids or asks priced within k bps of mid, bounds included; its live value (`live`) is the same statistic of this request's book, spread_bps not rounded to 2 decimals

live.description: The route's live value of the figure, the one the z-score compares with the stored values; null when the route has none

mean.description: Mean of the stored values; null while warming up

median.description: Median of the stored values; null while warming up

points.description: Stored slots of the figure in the window

stddev.description: Population standard deviation of the stored values (over the stored points); null while warming up

zscore.description: (live − mean) / population standard deviation of the stored values, rounded half-up to 2 decimals; null while warming up, when the standard deviation is 0 or without a live value

window.description: The baseline window: the 672 15-minute slots (7 days) up to the current one

baseline.description: The 7-day stored baseline of the book of the metric's direct pair, in the metric's base and quote order; null while every figure warms up, when no stored series tracks the pair, or when the stored series cannot be read or lacks a figure

components.description: The four components, in the order peg, spread, depth, amm_gap

contribution.description: weight × value_ratio, in score points, the unit of score

input_bps.description: Raw input of the peg, spread or amm_gap component in basis points, signed, before the absolute value and the clamp, rounded half-up to 2 decimals: peg's headline deviation_bps, the direct book's spread_bps, or (AMM spot − CLOB mid) / CLOB mid × 10000; null for depth, for amm_gap without a usable pool (the component is 0 by rule), or when the input is missing

input_depth.description: Raw input of the depth component: peg's depth_at_peg_50, in units of the body's asset; null for the other components or when the input is missing

input_missing.description: True when the component's input is missing, so the component counts its full weight and never reads like a maxed input (a one-sided direct book has no spread and no mid; a book whose close time is unknown is missing); false otherwise, also for amm_gap without a usable pool

name.description: peg: the peg deviation; spread: the direct book's spread; depth: the funded depth near the peg; amm_gap: the gap of the direct pool's spot to the book's mid

value_ratio.description: Normalized value of the component, a fraction from 0 to 1; 1 when its input is missing

weight.description: Weight of the component in score points, the unit of score: the four weights sum to 100, the range of score

reasons.description: issuer_global_freeze when the asset's issuer froze all its tokens; no_route, without such a freeze, when no route links the asset and its peg default; then at most one baseline reason: warming_up while a baseline figure has fewer than 288 stored slots; not_tracked when no stored series tracks the pair; baseline_unavailable when the stored series cannot be read or lacks a figure; empty otherwise

score.description: Integer from 0 to 100, the rounded sum of the contributions; 100 when the issuer has a global freeze; null without a route

title: XRPL liquidity stress
